test_title: PYST 30 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statements:

Some shirts are pants.

Some pants are trousers.

Conclusions:

I. Some shirts are trousers.

II. No shirt is a trouser.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some shirts are pants.

Some pants are trousers.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/511902b7900ef9d626705801a8ed031de616ed667ba5e6cef9492320d5ba03fd.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some shirts are trousers –

False (No definite link is given between shirts and trousers; the “some” parts may be different).

II. No shirt is a trouser –

False (It is also possible that some shirts could be trousers; not निश्चित).

Hence, either conclusion I or II follows.

The correct answer is **Option 3**.
